name: robin
description: Terminal agent for Anthropic, Copilot, Gemini, OpenRouter, Ollama and any OpenAI-compatible server, with a local gateway, tools, memory, skills and MCP
author: Samukelo "Batman" Magagula

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.//prepare: Runs on `npm install` from a git clone, so a fresh clone is runnable without anyone remembering to build. npm skips it when installing the published tarball, which already contains dist.

//dependencies: Exact-pinned, no ranges. A caret range lets a compromised patch release of any dependency reach a fresh install with no review on our side. Exact pins mean the only way a new version arrives is an intentional bump here plus a regenerated package-lock.json. Install with `npm ci`, not `npm install`.
//files: Only the built output ships. Without this npm publishes src, tests and every config too — 374 files where 60 will do, and the tests are not something an installer should be downloading.
